s: After listening it for many months first on Spotify and then on CD, I finally decided to buy the LP. It was everything I expected and more. The album is masterfully crafted. The print quality is amazing, and the art direction shines a bright light on the magnificent music of Kavinsky. If you want to lose yourself in a nostalgic era you will never ever experience again -i.e. The 80s', and you have a thing for vinyl music, you'll definitely want to buy this one.
